seoTitle: Which Breaking Bad Character Are You? Breaking Bad Test (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Breaking Bad test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Walter, Jesse, Skyler, Hank, Saul, Gus, Mike or Marie — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the mild-mannered teacher with a dangerous side, the kid who just wants out, or the one who can talk anyone out of anything? Answer 12 questions about how you really handle pressure, family and temptation, and find out which Breaking Bad character you are.

characters.name: Walter White
characters.title: The Brilliant Mastermind
characters.summary: Brilliant, proud and underestimated for far too long. Once you decide to take control, nothing stops you.
description: Like Walt, you're brilliant — and for years, nobody noticed. He was an overqualified high school chemistry teacher before everything changed.
You've got pride. Walt's need to be recognised for his genius drives almost everything he does.
You can be meticulous, strategic and ruthless when pushed. Just be careful who you become.
characters.flaw: Your pride and ego take over everything.
characters.signature: A pork-pie hat, sunglasses and "I am the one who knocks."

characters.name: Jesse Pinkman
characters.title: The Sensitive Survivor
characters.summary: Emotional, loyal and far kinder than you look. You've made bad choices, but your heart is in the right place.
description: Like Jesse, you feel everything. He's tougher on the outside than he is inside, and the guilt of what he's done weighs on him.
You care deeply about kids and people who can't protect themselves.
You're more talented than you think — Jesse once built a beautiful wooden box in shop class and never forgot it.
characters.flaw: You let people use you, and you struggle to forgive yourself.
characters.signature: A beanie, baggy clothes and "Yeah, science!"
characters.clashReason: they act on feelings instead of thinking it through

characters.name: Skyler White
characters.title: The Sharp Strategist
characters.summary: Smart, practical and nobody's fool. You notice everything, and when you're backed into a corner, you adapt fast.
description: Like Skyler, you see through lies. She knew something was wrong with Walt long before anyone else.
You're practical. Skyler ended up running the books for the family car wash with real skill.
You'll protect your children no matter what, even if it means making impossible choices.
characters.flaw: Once you're in, you get pulled in deeper than you ever meant to.
characters.signature: A ledger, a sharp look and a car wash that's doing surprisingly well.
characters.clashReason: they'd see through your lies — and use them

characters.name: Hank Schrader
characters.title: The Loud, Loyal Lawman
characters.summary: Loud, funny and a much better detective than people think. Underneath the bravado, you're a good man.
description: Like Hank, you're the life of the party — loud, jokey and full of stories.
But you're good at your job. Hank's a DEA agent who never stops chasing the truth, even when it leads somewhere he doesn't want to go.
You've got hobbies you take seriously. Hank brews his own beer and collects minerals. They're minerals, Marie.
characters.flaw: You hide your fears behind bravado.
characters.signature: A DEA badge, a home-brewed beer and a mineral collection.
characters.clashReason: they'd never stop digging until they found the truth

characters.name: Saul Goodman
characters.title: The Fast-Talking Fixer
characters.summary: Funny, slippery and endlessly resourceful. There's no problem you can't talk your way out of — for a fee.
description: Like Saul, you're a talker. He's the lawyer you call when you're in real trouble.
You're resourceful and always have a guy for whatever's needed.
You're funny, flashy and surprisingly good at what you do. Better call Saul!
characters.signature: A loud suit, a strip-mall office and a TV ad.
characters.clashReason: they'd find a loophole around every rule you care about

characters.name: Gus Fring
characters.title: The Calm Perfectionist
characters.summary: Composed, meticulous and always planning ten years ahead. People underestimate you — right up until they don't.
description: Like Gus, you're precise. Nothing about your life is left to chance.
You hide in plain sight. Gus runs the Los Pollos Hermanos restaurants — and a secret empire behind them.
You're patient and controlled. You never raise your voice, and that's exactly what makes you frightening.
characters.signature: A perfectly pressed shirt, rimless glasses and a restaurant uniform.
characters.clashReason: they'd smile at you while planning three steps ahead

characters.name: Mike Ehrmantraut
characters.title: The Quiet Professional
characters.summary: Calm, practical and deadly competent. You don't talk much, and you don't do half measures.
description: Like Mike, you're the professional. He's a former cop who handles the jobs nobody else can.
You're dry and blunt. Mike has no time for egos or drama.
Everything you do is for family. For Mike, that's his granddaughter.
characters.flaw: You've made peace with a life you know is wrong.
characters.signature: A tan jacket, leather gloves and "No more half measures."
characters.clashReason: they'd have zero patience for your mistakes

characters.name: Marie Schrader
characters.title: The Colourful Loyalist
characters.summary: Dramatic, opinionated and fiercely loyal to your family. And you really, really like purple.
description: Like Marie, you've got a signature style — almost everything she owns is purple.
You're dramatic and a bit self-absorbed, and you've got quirks you'd rather nobody knew about.
But when it matters, you're fiercely loyal and stronger than you look.

questions.text: You realise people have underestimated you for years. You...

options.text: Prove everyone wrong. Spectacularly
Let them keep underestimating you. It's useful
Shrug. You never cared what they thought
Quietly start building something of your own

questions.text: A friend asks you to help them get out of a speeding ticket. You...

options.text: Find a loophole. There's always a loophole
Tell them to pay it. Rules are rules
Not your problem. They can sort it out themselves
Help — then somehow make it all about you

questions.text: You've got free evenings for the first time in years. You pick up...

options.text: Something you can be the best at. You'll be teaching it by spring
Cooking. Precise, every detail right
Fishing. Quiet, and nobody bothers you
Stand-up comedy. You've got the material

questions.text: Someone close to you is lying to you. You...

options.text: Wait. They'll slip up eventually
Follow the evidence until you can prove it
Believe them. You really want to trust people
Take it very personally. Loudly

questions.text: You mess up, and someone gets hurt. You...

options.text: Can't stop thinking about it. For years
Tell yourself it wasn't really your fault
Fix it quietly, and make sure it never happens again
Call in a favour to make it go away

questions.text: A family member is clearly hiding something. You...

options.text: Snoop until you find out
Confront them directly
Pretend you haven't noticed. For now
Leave it. You've got secrets of your own

questions.text: You come into some unexpected money. You...

options.text: Buy something flashy. You deserve it
Save it quietly, for someone who needs it more than you
Blow it with your friends. Tonight
Invest it somewhere clever and watch it grow
Backyard barbecue with a cold beer you brewed yourself
Work. Your business is your weekend
Spend it with family. Quietly
Go round open houses — the ones with nice things

questions.text: Your family is facing a crisis. You...

options.text: Take charge and make every decision
Handle the money and keep everything running
Crack jokes so everyone keeps going
Show up with food, strong opinions and a lot of drama

questions.text: You find out you're seriously ill, and the treatment will leave your family broke. You...

options.text: Find a way to make serious money. Whatever it takes
Accept help from whoever offers it. Pride isn't worth it
Get the best lawyer you can and fight the insurance company
Keep it quiet and make sure your family's taken care of

questions.text: You find out someone close to you is secretly the drug kingpin the police have been hunting for years. You...

options.text: Bring them down. Family or not
Tell everyone. They need to know what this person did
Keep it to yourself. Knowing is leverage
Warn them. They deserve a chance to run

questions.text: You're offered a lot of money to do something you're brilliant at — but it's illegal. You...

options.text: Just once. Then it's more than once
Do it properly and professionally — or not at all
Take a cut, and make sure it's all 'technically' legal
Say no — then get dragged into it anyway
